title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Orsières, 27–29 August, 2015–2025
claims: For Orsières on 27–29 August in 2015–2025 there are 33 daily records: daily maximum 13.0–29.1 °C (median 25.9 °C), daily minimum 8.8–19.1 °C (median 14.2 °C), 14 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 9 days with at least 5 mm.
The station is a valley grid point, not a measurement at the Col de Balme ridge or at Tête de Balme.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 27–29 August; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
